review.why: Guides building MCP servers in TypeScript or Python in four phases: research, implementation, testing and evaluations.
review.summary: Phase one studies the protocol and picks stack and tools; phase two builds shared infrastructure and tools with typed schemas and safety annotations; phase three builds and tests with the MCP inspector; phase four writes ten read-only evaluation questions with verified answers in an XML file. It covers both TypeScript SDK versions and points to language guides and scripts.
strengths: Evaluation phase with realistic read-only questions and verifiable answers
Clear advice on tool naming, errors and pagination
Handles the SDK v1 to v2 split
cautions: Fetches protocol and SDK docs from the web at run time
Language guides and two scripts are not read here
Needs a Node or Python toolchain
